record.question: The solution used to disinfect the bed linen of HIV positive patient is:
record.explanation: Answer D: Sodium Hypochlorite. Sodium hypochlorite is an effective chlorine disinfectant for appropriately handled contaminated laundry/surfaces; detergent brand products such as Dettol, Lysol, and Savlon are not the specific chlorine answer. Source/context note: HIV is not transmitted through ordinary linens; standard precautions and the facility laundry protocol apply. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/infection-control/hcp/disinfection-sterilization/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
